summary: Added `first_played` to the Deck model (src/sensei_top/api/models/common.py) between last_played and first_seen. Rewrote decks() in src/sensei_top/api/routes/meta.py as one query: a grouped `first_played` CTE (MIN(m.started_at) over matches JOIN v_match_deck, GROUP BY md.deck_id) LEFT JOINed to v_deck_summary, with WHERE s.matches_played > 0 so unpicked MTGO decks are dropped, keeping the same ORDER BY; docstring updated. Regenerated web/src/types/api.ts with pnpm gen:types. Changed versionDays in web/src/lib/deckOverview.ts to take Pick<Deck, 'first_played'|'first_seen'|'last_played'> and start at first_played ?? first_seen, doc comment updated. All five checks passed (pytest 183, ruff, gen:types, vitest 496, tsc+lint).
concerns: Deck.first_played is declared before first_seen but the SQL selects first_seen before fp.first_played — harmless, ordering is by field name not select order.
The CTE includes deck_ids whose started_at is NULL via LEFT JOIN probe; MIN ignores NULLs, so unmatched decks get NULL first_played as intended.
gen:types also rewrote the OpenAPI description text in api.ts (docstring-derived); confirm the reviewer expects that regeneration diff.
